comparison.objective: Seat a vessel upright in a bay while maintaining clearance from a crew hand; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Collision-aware transport and upright placement versus hex-key engagement, fine adjustment, counterholding, and torque control.
comparison.success_condition: Vessel within 5 degrees upright and at least 5 cm from the hand versus two safe impact cycles with retained setting. No separate specs are supplied.
comparison.reason: Human-clearance-aware placement is a different tested ability from mechanical commissioning.
